# Nvidia Pre-Meeting Briefing: Q3 FY2027 Earnings Week (17 November 2026)

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Coverage window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026
**Basis:** Publicly available reporting and company releases supplied for this review. This briefing is informational and is not investment advice.

## Executive Summary

- **Leadership change:** Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member with immediate effect. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while keeping her CFO role, and the board is searching for a permanent successor ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition); [Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)).
- **Market reaction:** Shares fell more than 13% in early trading on 12 November ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). The stock closed at $162.85 on 13 November, about 32% below the record close of $239.24 on 6 October ([Tickeron, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753)).
- **Regulatory overhang:** The Justice Department and Commerce Department are investigating whether a Singaporean company bought advanced Nvidia chips to send to China ([CNN, 2026](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)).
- **Near-term catalyst:** Q3 FY2027 results on 17 November, against company guidance of $108 billion ±2% ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)).
- **Our view:** The transition is primarily a governance and reputational shock. Operating indicators in the sources remain strong, so the meeting should focus on succession, compliance and the durability of the AI spending cycle.

## 1. Situation Snapshot

| Next results | Q3 FY2027, 17 November, about 1:20 p.m. PT; call at 2 p.m. PT | [NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition) |
| Revenue guidance | $108.0 billion ±2% (about $105.84–110.16 billion) | [OANDA, 2026](https://www.oanda.com/eu-en/blog/NVIDIA-q3-earnings-preview-nov-2026) |
| Gross margin guidance | 74.0% ±50 basis points | [CapitalMEG, 2026](https://www.cmelitegroup.com/knowledge-hub/nvidia-earnings-date) |
| Market capitalisation | About $4.51 trillion (13 November) | [Tickeron, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753) |
| Investor Relations contact | Toshiya Hari, ir@nvidia.com | [NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition) |

## 2. What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### 2.1 Leadership and Governance

Huang's departure ends a 33-year tenure as head of the company he co-founded in 1993. Mashable described it as the first CEO change in the company's 33-year history ([Mashable, 2026](https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)). The board accepted the resignation on 11 November, a day before the announcement ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). The company did not give a reason in its statement ([Mashable, 2026](https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)).

Media reports link the departure to personal conduct. Al Jazeera reports that Huang resigned following allegations of extramarital affairs ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)). Yahoo Finance reports that Huang acknowledged a separate relationship with a woman whom US intelligence officials believe is a Chinese spy ([Howley, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-ceo-huang-resigns-amid-affair-scandals-board-names-cfo-colette-kress-interim-ceo-135801377.html)). These are reported claims. The Justice Department has said it has not yet determined whether the woman is a Chinese spy ([CNN, 2026](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)).

Harvey C. Jones, a director since 1993 and former CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys, was named the first-ever board chair ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). Independent board members issued a statement on 10 November ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)). Two further board statements and a message to the company were dated 8 November ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)). The newsroom listing shows only titles, so their content could not be verified here.

### 2.2 Investigations and Political Pressure

- **Congressional pressure:** House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said he was prepared to subpoena Huang unless he responded by 11 November to a request for a closed-door briefing. No subpoena had been issued at the time of reporting ([Lanz, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-erases-2026-gains-republicans-204550552.html)). A CNN headline indicates Huang has since been summoned to testify, but the excerpt available does not include the details ([CNN, 2026](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)).
- **Export-control inquiry:** The Justice Department is investigating, with the Commerce Department, whether a Singaporean company bought advanced Nvidia chips to send to China ([CNN, 2026](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)).
- **China exposure:** Nvidia's prior quarterly outlook assumed no data-centre compute revenue from China ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). OANDA notes that the guidance excludes sales of Data Center compute chips to China ([Kamiński, 2026](https://www.oanda.com/eu-en/blog/NVIDIA-q3-earnings-preview-nov-2026)).
- **Data-centre regulation:** Tickeron attributes the early-November sell-off mainly to concerns over potential data-centre regulation and a broader AI-sector repricing, rather than to Nvidia's reported fundamentals ([Evans, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753)).
